# Primary Analysis: Cheatgrass and Wildlife

## Setup

### Libraries

```{r}
#| output: false
library(here)
```

### Data Processing

The first step is to process raw data (found in `/data/raw/`) into analysis ready formats (saved to `/data/processed/`), all following tidy data conventions.

```{r}
#| output: false
source(here::here("R", "01_vegetation_survey_processing.R"))
source(here::here("R", "02_bird_count_processing.R"))
source(here::here("R", "03_butterfly_count_processing.R"))
source(here::here("R", "04_mammal_count_processing.R"))
source(here::here("R", "05_additional_data_processing.R"))
```

This tidy data can then be converted into summary tables that formatted for the following analysis (saved to `/data/summarized/`).

```{r}
#| output: false
source(here::here("R", "06_summarize_for_analysis.R"))
```

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
